text:
Alex: Heads-up — seeing recurring p99 latency spikes on canary for the 7B-quant pipeline under high concurrency. Root cause looks tied to KV cache evictions + larger microbatching mix.
Priya: Can you paste the p95/p99 numbers and the run id?
Alex: run=canary-2026-02-16-07
Alex: baseline (mb=2, kv_resident=0.8): p95=48ms, p99=112ms
Alex: experiment (mb=8, kv_eviction=aggressive): p95=60ms, p99=420ms 😬
Jorge: do we have kernel selection logs from the runtime when this happens?
Alex: yes — snippet:
[2026-02-16T07:12:03Z] selected_kernel=matmul_tiled_fast seq_len=32 batch=8
[2026-02-16T07:12:03Z] fallback_kernel=matmul_reference seq_len=7 batch=3 reason=small_seq_mismatch
[2026-02-16T07:12:03Z] kv_evict=token-prefix user=svc-123 evicted=1
[2026-02-16T07:12:03Z] kernel_reload=autotune triggered
Priya: eviction is fragmenting seq_len distribution inside microbatches -> autotuner flips to slower kernel for subset, dragging tail.
Sasha: repro steps? I'll run on a 3090 node.
Alex: repro:
1) ./tools/loadtest --model runner:7b-quant --qps 120 --concurrency 64 --mb 8
2) curl -X POST $CANARY/admin/kv/evict?action=simulate
Jorge: profiling summary:
GPU: 70% matmul_fast, 20% matmul_ref, 10% other
CPU: scheduling + serialize 30ms spikes
When matmul_ref appears p99 jumps ~3-4x.
Rui: autotuner too reactive to short-term seq_len variance caused by cache misses. Need hysteresis / prefer low-latency kernels when SLOs at risk.
Priya: also microbatch heuristics should avoid mixing very short KV-miss sequences with long ones — seq_len bucketing.
Sasha: quick experiment: cap microbatch to 4 under KV pressure and increase window to get homogeneous seqs.
Alex: ran grid (mb in {1,2,4,8} x kv_resident in {0.9,0.6,0.3}) summary:
- mb=1: p99 130-150ms (stable)
- mb=2: best p95, p99 110-160ms
- mb=4: p95 slightly higher, p99 180-260ms when kv_resident<=0.6
- mb=8: p99 350-500ms if kv_resident<=0.6
Conclusion: higher microbatch increases throughput but causes exponential tail when eviction active.
Jorge: trace shows `autotune -> recompile -> fallback` loop ~200ms after eviction events.
Alex: short-term mitigations: set microbatch.max=4, kernel.autotune.hysteresis_ms=5000, kv.eviction.min_resident_ratio=0.6 for workload-tagged routes.
Priya: long-term: EWMA-based kernel selection + penalize frequent kernel switches when p99>SLO; add microbatch bucketing by length.
Rui: +1. Consider prefer_low_latency flag per route so enterprise SLOs bias kernel choice.
Sasha: deploying canary-rc-11 with the changes now.
infra-bot: started job canary-rc-11:jobs/5112 (allocating nodes)
Alex: initial canary numbers after patch (mb.max=4, hysteresis=5s, kv.min_resident=0.6): p95=72ms, p99=128ms under same load.
Priya: action items:
- Jorge: add trace points for kernel_select and kv_eviction (EOD)
- Sasha: run full throughput sweep and post CSV to #eng-runtime (tomorrow)
- Rui/Eng-ML: design EWMA-based policy + sim harness (next sprint)
- Alex: draft rollback/rollforward plan and update canary config (now)
Alex: filing perf task infra/runner#2789 and short postmortem note. Will reopen if canary regresses. :thumbsup:
